name: NeRFifyMesh
definition: A pipeline for converting textured mesh models into Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) by generating a ground-truth point-based radiance field from mesh geometry and texture, eliminating the need for multi-view image rendering or camera pose supervision during training.
summary: NeRFifyMesh converts textured 3D meshes into NeRFs by training separate networks for color, normals, and opacity directly on mesh-derived samples, eliminating the need for multi-view images.
